excerpt: What would a record by a Dominican Republic-raised Cuban artist now residing in Brooklyn sound like? Well, all of those places at once if you're Charlie Chimi and this is the debut artist album for Coco Maria's new label. Afro-Cuban rhythms, no-wave garage punk edge, homemade funk and a fearless middle-fingered attitude towards generic straightforwardness are all here. It's also fun, surreal, irreverent and ace.
